name: Twenty
tagline: Open source CRM. Modern UI, GraphQL API, Postgres.
shortDescription: A modern open source CRM built with React, NestJS, and Postgres. Customizable objects, GraphQL API, workflow automations, beautiful UI. The Notion-meets-Salesforce.
longDescription:
## What it is

Twenty is a modern open source CRM. Built with React (frontend), NestJS (backend), and Postgres (DB). Custom objects, GraphQL API, workflow automations, email integration, beautiful UI inspired by Notion.

## Why we recommend it

The most exciting new open source CRM in years. Twenty is built like a modern SaaS — fast, beautiful, and developer-friendly. The GraphQL API and custom objects make it a real alternative to Salesforce/HubSpot for small teams.

## When to use it

- Building a CRM that you can fully customize
- Replacing HubSpot/Salesforce for a small team
- A CRM that fits your exact sales process
- When you want a beautiful UI without per-seat fees
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty && cd twenty && yarn && yarn start
installInstructions:
**Local dev:**
```
git clone https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty
cd twenty
yarn
yarn start
```
Frontend at `http://localhost:3001`.

**Cloud:** Twenty Cloud (managed) — sign up at twenty.com.
pricingDetails: Open source. Self-host free. Twenty Cloud has a free tier for small teams.
